title: The Kept Secret of the Caves

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE III: DEFENSE, RAIDS AND THE FALLEN (LCC-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
"If anyone comes to raid our homeland, we'll be ready." Isola's people are peaceful but no pushovers: stamping dances and war chants, watch fires and plans, raids fended off or not, prisoners and bargains, and how the village honors those who defended it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: An elder knows a hidden escape way through the caves: share it with everyone, or only with the warriors.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject)'s family has kept a secret for generations: a hidden way through the caves under the cliff, which comes out on the far side of the island. In a raid, the whole village could escape that way. But a secret everyone knows is not a secret, and the raiders might learn it too. (friend) has asked (subject) to share it. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) shows the whole village the hidden way, a few families at a time. It is a long, dark, cold walk, and a child gets lost in it for an hour. But now everyone knows it. (subject)'s family says the old ones would understand. (subject) hopes so.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) shows only the warriors and a few elders. The rest of the village knows there is a way, but not where. Some people resent being trusted less. (subject) says the secret has kept the village safe for a hundred years, and will keep it safe a little longer.
